Cover, Unstable**

battleProfile.name: Magore's Fiends
notes: This unit cannot be reinforced

abilities.name: Bloodfury
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect:
Both player's roll off. If you win the roll-off, pick a melee weapon that the target is armed with. Your opponent must pick a visible unit in their army within 3" of the target (they can pick the target's own unit, and even if it is a single-model unit).
Your opponent must resolve combat attacks for the target using the melee weapon you picked against the unit they picked.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy model within 3" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Crimson Haze
abilities.effect: While this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^Bloodbound^^** units, excluding **Wrathmongers** units, while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Words of Hate
abilities.effect:
While this terrain feature has an **Invoker**:
• Add 1 to chanting rolls for the **Invoker**.
• The **Invoker** cannot use **^^Move^^** abilities.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to the **Invoker**, measure to this terrain feature instead.
• All attacks that would target the **Invoker** target this terrain feature instead.
• If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the **Invoker**. Then, set up the **Invoker** on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer an **Invoker**. If it is not possible to set up the **Invoker**, it is slain.

abilities.name: Ascend the Altar
abilities.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now an Invoker (see 'Words of Hate').
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature does not have an **Invoker**, pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Infantry Priest^^** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.

abilities.name: Hatred of Sorcery
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Resolve the effect of the 'Banish Manifestation' ability for each target. If any **^^Endless Spells^^** are banished by this ability, you gain 1 **blood tithe** point.
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature has an **Invoker**, pick up to D3 enemy **^^Endless Spells^^** within 18" of this terrain feature to be the target(s) and make a **banishment roll** of 2D6 for each target.

abilities.name: Descend the Altar
abilities.effect: If this terrain feature has an **Invoker** that was not placed on it this turn, set up the **Invoker** on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer an **Invoker**.

rules.name: Skull Altar
rules.description:

Cover, Impassable**

abilities.name: Brass Stampede
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through models in the target unit and must end that move in combat.
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

abilities.name: Reality-Splitting Axe
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, the target is automatically destroyed and cannot be replaced for the rest of the battle.
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed. Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** that was allocated any damage points by this unit's **Axe of Khorne** this turn to be the target.

abilities.name: Howl of Blood-Curdling Savagery
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: The target can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the target has charged.
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a visible friendly **^^Bloodbound^^** unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat to be the target. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Retinue of Blood

abilities.effect: The targets' melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly **^^Bloodbound Hero^^** within this unit's combat range to be the targets.

abilities.name: Master of the Goretide
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: Spend 3 **blood tithe points** and pick a friendly **^^Bloodbound^^** unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.

abilities.name: Reality-Splitting Axe
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, one model in that unit is slain.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by combat attacks made by this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Loathe the Arcane
abilities.effect: This unit can use this ability if it is not in combat. This unit can move 3" but must end that move closer to the unit that used the **^^Spell^^** ability. It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: Ascended Warlord
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Axe of Khorne** for each other friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit that is within this unit's combat range and in combat.

abilities.name: Reality-Splitting Axe
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, one model in that unit is slain.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by combat attacks made by this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Trophies of Glorious Deaths
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 8" of this unit
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost. This reaction cannot be used more than once per command.

abilities.name: Killer of Kings
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model from that unit is slain, or, if the target is a **^^Manifestation^^**, it is automatically destroyed.
abilities.declare: Pick each enemy unit and **^^Manifestation^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Khornate Hound
abilities.effect: This unit's **Kannat** is a token. Each time you declare a **^^Fight^^** ability for this unit while its **Kannat** is on the battlefield, as a reaction, you can remove its **Kannat** from the battlefield and then add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's **Bloodied Weapons** for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Gather the Skulls
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain and you earn 1 blood tithe point.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Obliterating Charge
abilities.effect: Add **X** to charge rolls for friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** units, where **X** is the number of friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Cavalry^^** or **^^Monster^^** units that have already charged this phase and that are wholly within 12" of the unit being rolled for.

abilities.name: Butchers of Nations
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Fight^^** ability for a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Daemon^^** unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly **^^Bloodbound^^** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: Eager Killers
abilities.effect: Each friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Daemon^^** unit that has used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is not in combat can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Tireless Conquerors
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Bloodbound^^** units that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.

abilities.name: Bloody Competitors
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of each other, add 1 to wound rolls for the targets' combat attacks.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Bloodbound^^** unit and a friendly non-**^^Hero Blades of Khorne Daemon^^** unit to be the targets.

abilities.name: Tide of Savagery
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Add 2" to the targets' Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Bloodbound Hero^^** and up to 2 other friendly ^^**Bloodbound^^** units that are wholly within 12" of that **^^Hero^^** to be the targets.

abilities.name: Blood-drenched
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Skulls for the Skull Throne' ability
abilities.effect:
After that ability has been resolved, if you unlocked a **^^Blood Tithe^^** ability this turn, pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit to be the target. The following effects apply to the target for the rest of the battle:
***Wild-eyed Brutality:*** Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** units.
***Blood Haze:*** **Blood-hungry** weapons used by friendly **^^Bloodbound^^** units have **Crit (Mortal)**.
***Weapons of Murder:*** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of **Blood-hungry** weapons used by friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** non-**^^Monster Daemon^^** units, including **Blood-hungry Companion** weapons.
***Bloodlords Supreme:*** Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of **Blood-hungry** weapons used by friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Monster^^** units.

abilities.name: Blood for the Blood God
abilities.effect: Earn 1 blood tithe point each time a unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed. Blood tithe points are spent to unlock **^^Blood Tithe^^** abilities. You can only use **^^Blood Tithe^^** abilities that are unlocked. Once a **^^Blood Tithe^^** ability is unlocked, you do not need to spend further blood tithe points to use it.

abilities.name: Skulls for the Skull Throne
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Pick a **^^Blood Tithe^^** ability that you have not unlocked and spend the number of blood tithe points required to unlock that ability. That **^^Blood Tithe^^** ability is now unlocked for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Murderlust
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Charge^^** ability.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. You can replace one of the dice in the charge roll with that value. If you do so, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit using that **^^Charge^^** ability after that ability is resolved.
abilities.unlockCondition: You do not need to unlock this ability. It is already unlocked.

abilities.name: Divine Scorn
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Start of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the target's power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of the next turn.
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy **^^Wizards^^** or **^^Priests^^** within 6" of any friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** units to be the target(s).

abilities.name: Punish the Pacifist
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1-2, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy target.
abilities.declare: Each unit (friendly and enemy) and enemy **^^Manifestation^^** that is not in combat is a target.

abilities.name: Murder the Mystic
abilities.effect: Make a **banishment roll** of 2D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on that **^^Manifestation^^**'s warscroll, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of it and then it is **banished** and removed from play.
abilities.declare: Pick up to 4 enemy **^^Manifestations^^** to be the target(s).
abilities.unlockCondition: You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked 'Divine Scorn'.

abilities.name: Glorious Combat or Naught
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** units.
abilities.unlockCondition: You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked 'Divine Scorn' or 'Punish the Pacifist'.

abilities.name: Revel in Battle
abilities.effect: Other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by enemy units that charged this turn and that target a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit have no effect.
abilities.unlockCondition: You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked 'Punish the Pacifist'.

abilities.name: Slaughter Triumphant
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** units that charged in the same turn.
abilities.unlockCondition: You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked 'Glorious Combat or Naught' or 'Murder the Mystic'.

abilities.name: Cleave Wide the Grin of Khorne
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** units.
abilities.unlockCondition: You can only unlock this ability if you have already unlocked 'Revel in Battle' or Glorious Combat or Naught'.

rules.description: **Designer's Note** Unlocking a **^^Blood Tithe^^** ability does not lock you out of the other abilities on the same tier. For an ability to become available to unlock, one of the previous abilities noted in the Unlock Conditions needs to already be unlocked.

abilities.name: Sigil of Doom
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the **blood tithe points** cost of the chosen ability, , until the start of your next turn, the effects of that ability apply to the target as if it had been unlocked.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit wholly within 8" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target. Then, pick a passive **^^Blood Tithe^^** ability that you have not unlocked this battle.

abilities.name: Summon Bleeding Icon
abilities.effect: Set up a **Bleeding Icon** wholly within 18" of the chanter and visible to them.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Bleeding Icon** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.name: Hexgorgers
abilities.effect: For each part of this **^^Manifestation^^** that is within 8" of a **^^Wizard^^** (friendly or enemy), subtract 1 from casting rolls for that **^^Wizard^^**.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect:
When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.
Each time this **^^Manifestation^^** moves, both its parts must end within 8" of each other. Each part of this **^^Manifestation^^** is armed with a **Stream of Molten Blood**.

abilities.name: Summon Hexgorger Skulls
abilities.effect: Set up a **Hexgorger Skulls** invocation wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Hexgorger Skulls** invocation has 2 parts that must be set up within 8" of each other.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Hexgorger Skulls** invocation on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.declare: If this **^^Manifestation^^** charged this turn, pick an enemy unit with a starting size greater than 1 that is in combat with this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.

abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Wrath-axe** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Bleeding Icon** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Wrath-axe** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.name: Stoke the Flames
abilities.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• When resolving the damage sequence for enemy units in combat with the target, your opponent cannot spend rage dice as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability.
• If the target is destroyed, you gain 1 rage dice. If the chanting roll was 6+, you gain 2 rage dice instead.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.name: Gift of Apoplexy
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability that is not a **^^Move^^** or **^^Fight^^** ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 3 mortal damage instead of D3.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.name: Fetters of Blood
abilities.effect:
If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
• The targets cannot use **^^Retreat^^** or **^^Run^^** abilities.
• The targets cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow them to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield or in reserve.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.name: Blood Boil
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.name: Uncontrollable Rage
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the effects of the 'Blood-drenched' ability (see 'Battle Traits') apply to the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, ignore the effect of 'Wild-eyed Brutality' on the target.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.name: Final Act of Violence
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the chanting roll as 8+, roll 2 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.effect: This unit can use **^^Unbind^^** abilities as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**. Each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

abilities.declare: Pick each enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's combat attacks to be the targets.

abilities.name: Ar'gath, the King of Blades
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy **^^Heroes^^** while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Magical Scorn

Subtract 1 from casting rolls for **^^Wizards^^** while they are within 12" of this unit.
Subtract 1 from chanting rolls for enemy **^^Priests^^** while they are within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Skull Collector

If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **^^Hero^^** by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy **^^Hero^^** has been destroyed, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the battle.
This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

abilities.name: Frenzied Taskmaster
abilities.effect: The target can move D6" but cannot end that move in combat. If the target ends that move within this unit's combat range, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Titanic Boulderclub** is 11 for **Calamitous Sweep** and 4 for **Crushing Blow**.

abilities.name: Don't Stomp Those; Stomp Them!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: The target can move 2D6". It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that it was in combat with at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly **^^Big^^** or **^^Little^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that has not been set up this turn to be the target.

abilities.name: Almightier Stompin'
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.effect:
Make a rampage roll of D3. For the rest of the turn, add the roll to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Almighty Stomp**, but all of this unit's attacks made with that weapon must target the target unit.

If any models are slain by those attacks, for the rest of the turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

abilities.name: Titanic Boulderclub
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a **^^Fight^^** ability, pick either the **Calamitous Sweep** or **Crushing Blow** weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its **Titanic Boulderclub**.

abilities.name: Titanic Stride
abilities.effect: The unit in this Regiment of Renown can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the unit in this Regiment of Renown by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Earth-shaking Stomp
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy **^^Infantry^^** and **^^Cavalry^^** units while they are in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Carve a Path to Glory
abilities.effect: This unit can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn. When using the second **^^Fight^^** ability, this unit must pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** to be the target of all of its attacks.
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is in combat with an enemy **^^Hero^^**.

abilities.name: Oath of Bloodshed
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^Gunnar's Oathsworn^^** units have **^^Ward (4+)^^** for the rest of the battle.
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if any enemy **^^Heroes^^** were slain by this unit's combat attacks this turn.

abilities.name: Swift as the Wind
abilities.effect: Only critical hits score successful hits for shooting attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: Uncanny Shot
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's **Singri's Warbow** for attacks that target enemy units that are within 6" of a friendly **Gunnar Brand**.

abilities.name: Broken Nadja
abilities.effect: While this unit's **Broken Nadja** is on the battlefield, it has **^^Wizard (1)^^**.

abilities.name: Withering Death
abilities.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target and subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Hero^^** within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Favour of the Gods
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect:

abilities.name: Blood Rites
abilities.effect:
You perform a blood rite each time:
• An enemy unit is destroyed and any damage points were allocated to that unit by a friendly **anointed** unit's combat attacks in the same turn.
• A friendly **anointed** unit is destroyed.
• A friendly unit contesting an objective you control is destroyed.
• An enemy unit is destroyed by a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit's attacks and any models in that enemy unit were contesting an objective you do not control in the same phase.
• A unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed and it was within 3" of a **Place of Power** at the start of the phase.
Only one blood rite can be performed per unit destroyed.

abilities.name: Anointed Ritualist

abilities.declare: If there are no friendly **anointed** units on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-Unique **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** Hero on the battlefield to be the target.

abilities.name: Bloody Succession

abilities.name: Blessings of Khaine
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following blessings that is not **active**. That blessing is **active**. While a blessing is **active**, its effect applies to friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** units. The effects of more than 1 blessing can apply to a unit at the same time.
•  **Blessing of Ruthlessness**: Add 1 to hit rolls for those units' combat attacks.
•  **Blessing of Hatred**: Add 1 to wound rolls for those units' combat attacks.
•  **Blessing of Haste**: Add 3" to those units' Move characteristic.
•  **Blessing of Zeal**: If those units charged in the same turn, they have **^^Ward (5+)^^** for the rest of the turn.
•  **Blessing of Shadow**: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target those units.
•  **Blessing of Cruelty**: Those units can use **^^Charge^^** and/or **^^Shoot^^** abilities even if they have used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn.
•  **Blessing of Clarity**: Add 1 to chanting rolls and casting rolls for those units.
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if you performed any blood rites this turn.

**Bloodwrack Sorceress** only. Add the **Bloodwrack Stare** and **Guardians' Blades** weapons and the 'Invoke Murder' ability to your hero's warscroll. 
In addition, make the following changes to your hero's warscroll:
• Change the Health characteristic to 12.
• Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
• Change the Control characteristic to 5.
• Replace the **^^Infantry^^** keyword with the **^^War Machine^^** keyword.

rules.name: Swift
rules.description: **^^Cavalry^^** only. Add 2" to your hero's Move characteristic.

rules.name: Barding
rules.description: **^^Cavalry^^** only. Your hero has a Save characteristic of 5+.

rules.name: Dark Pegasus
rules.description: **^^Cavalry^^** only. Your hero has the **^^Fly^^** keyword.

abilities.name: Brand of Khaine
abilities.effect:
If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn:
• Add the roll to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Companion** weapons.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's **Companion** weapons.

rules.name: Brand of Khaine
rules.description: Add the 'Brand of Khaine' ability to your hero's warscroll.

rules.name: Steed of Dark Flames
rules.description: **^^Cavalry^^** only. Add the 'Steed of Dark Flames' ability to your hero's warscroll.

rules.name: Iron-bound
rules.description: **^^War Machine^^** only. Add 2 to your hero's Health characteristic.

rules.name: Fanatical Guardians
rules.description: **^^War Machine^^** only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of your hero's **Guardian Blades**.

rules.name: Torrent of Burning Blood
rules.description: **^^War Machine Priest^^** only. Add the **Torrent of Burning Blood** ability to your hero's warscroll.

abilities.name: Born of Slaughter
abilities.effect: Set up an **Avatar of Khaine** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: If there are fewer friendly **Avatars of Khaine** on the battlefield than there are friendly **Bloodwrack Shrines** on the battlefield, make a casting roll of 2D6.

rules.name: Born of Slaughter
rules.description: **^^War Machine Wizard^^** only. Add the 'Born of Slaughter' ability to your hero's warscroll.

rules.name: Aelven Grace

rules.description: Add 1 to your hero's Health characteristic.

rules.name: Gift of Khaine

rules.name: Killing Grace
rules.description: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your hero's **Cult Blade**.

rules.name: Word of Khaine
rules.description: Non-**^^War Machine^^** only. Add the 'Word of Khaine' weapon to your hero's warscroll.

rules.name: Master of Poisons

rules.name: Ferocious Cultist
rules.description: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of your hero's **Cult Blade**.

abilities.name: Masterful Executioner
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of damage points the target has, inflict an amount of mortal damage equal to the roll.
abilities.declare: Pick a damaged enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

rules.name: Masterful Executioner
rules.description: Add the 'Masterful Executioner' ability to your hero's warscroll.

rules.name: Blistering Speed
rules.description: **^^Infantry^^** only. Your hero has **^^Strike-first^^**.

abilities.name: Shadowmeld
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

rules.name: Shadowmeld
rules.description: **^^Fly^^** only. Add the 'Shadowmeld' ability to yout hero's warscroll.

rules.name: Cult Fanatic
rules.description: **^^Wizard or Priest^^** only. Your hero's power level is 2.

abilities.name: Bloodmad
abilities.effect: While this unit is within 3" of any visible damaged units (friendly or enemy), add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with this unit's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Screeching Evangelist
abilities.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Lethal Blademaster
abilities.effect: Attacks made with this unit's melee weapons score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

abilities.name: Ear-bursting Shriek
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll and the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Hero^^** within 10" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Blade of Shadow
abilities.effect: The Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons is equal to the current battle round number, unless it would be higher.

abilities.name: Flickering Blur
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (3+)^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Bellowed Exhortations
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If you have used the 'Blessings of Khaine' ability 3 or more times this battle, the target's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 4+ for the rest of the turn. Otherwise, roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the current battle round number, the target's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 4+ for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**^^Hero Daughters of Khaine^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Blessed of the Goddess
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, if you picked a **Heart of Fury**, set it up wholly within 18" of this unit and visible to it. Otherwise, on a 4+, set up the **^^Manifestation^^** wholly within 12" of this unit, visible to it and more than 9" from all enemy units. This unit has summoned that **^^Manifestation^^**.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Manifestation^^** that is not on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Lethal Grace
abilities.effect: Add 2 to run rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Ferocious and Fearless
abilities.effect: Add 3 to this unit's control score if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Shield of Blades
abilities.effect: Shooting attacks that target this unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead). If the unmodified hit roll for a shooting attack that targets this unit is 6, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: A Thousand Cuts
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll and the target cannot use **^^Rampage^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Shadow-blessed
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than **X**" from all enemy units, where **X** is equal to 10 minus the current battle round number.

abilities.name: First Blood
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: This unit has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Fangs of the Viper
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this unit's attacks.

abilities.name: Fleet-footed Killers
abilities.effect: Add 4" to this unit's Move characteristic.

abilities.name: Radiant Transmogrification
abilities.effect:
Roll 2 dice, pick either result, then apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the turn:
**1** No effect.
**2-3** **Heal (D3)** each friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy target.
**4** Friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** targets can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if they used a **^^Run^^** ability in the same turn. Enemy targets cannot use **^^Run^^** abilities.
**5** Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
**6** Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by  friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** targets. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
abilities.declare: This **^^Manifestation^^** must use this ability in each hero phase. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the targets.

abilities.name: Jaws of Fate
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Snapping Jaws** for each **fate point** you have.

abilities.name: Compendium of Darkness
abilities.effect:
The target can immediately use a **^^Spell^^** ability from the Lore of Change or the Lore of Fate.
**Designer's Note**: *That spell does not count towards the number of **^^Spell^^** or **^^Banish^^** abilities the target can use this phase.*
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.

abilities.effect:

abilities.effect:
If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **^^Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** by this unit's attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed:

• Add 1 to this unit's power level for the rest of the battle.
This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a unit within 30" of this unit.

While a friendly **Idolarc** is next to an enemy unit, subtract 1" from that enemy unit's Move characteristic for each **fate point** you have. This ability cannot reduce an enemy unit's Move characteristic below half its unmodified value.
abilities.declare: If this unit has any models carrying an **Antithete Bow**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's **Mighty Sorcerous Bolt** while its **Brimstone Horror** is on the battlefield. abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: The next time a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit uses a **^^Spell^^** ability this phase, when picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from this terrain feature instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to this terrain feature instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.

abilities.name: Sorcerous Duplication
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• If there is only 1 friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, set up another **Argent Shard** wholly within 12" of this terrain feature, more than 1" from all other terrain features, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 9" from all enemy units.
• Remove this terrain feature from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 1" from all other terrain features, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.name: Argent Shard
rules.description:
**The following universal terrain abilities apply to this terrain feature (Terrain, 1.2):
Cover, Impassable**

abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is **masked by illusion**. Pick up to 1 other friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the target.

abilities.name: Long in the Planning

abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time an enemy unit ends a charge move within 3" of the target, you can remove the target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **masked by illusion**.

abilities.name: Masters of Destiny
abilities.effect:
Roll 9 dice and place them to one side. These are your **destiny dice**. **Destiny dice** can be spent during the battle to change certain dice rolls. You can never have more thna 9 **Destiny dice** at once.
During the battle, instead of making a roll from the list below for a friendly **^^Oracle of Fate^^** unit, you can spend your **destiny dice**. The roll you would have made is replaced with the roll on the **destiy dice** you spend. If you want to replace a 2D6 roll, 3D6 roll, etc. you must spend a number of **destiny dice** equal to the number before 'D6'. Any rolls that have been replaced count as unmodified rolls, and they cannot be re-rolled or modified by other friendly abilities except for those that apply negative modifiers (but they can be modified by enemy abilities). You cannot spend **destiny dice** to replace re-rolls.
**Destiny dice** can be spent in place of the following dice rolls:
• Casting rolls
• Unbinding rolls
• Banishment rolls
• Run rolls
• Charge rolls in your turn
• Hit rolls
• Wound rolls
• Save rolls

abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Your Turn

Re-roll all of your unspent **destiny dice**. Then, until the start of your next turn:
• Friendly **^^Oracles of Fate^^** units have **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
• Subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units.
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if the total value of your unspent **destiny dice** is exactly 9.

abilities.effect: On a delusion roll of 1-2, you must pick a different **^^Delusion^^** to the one you picked last turn. On a 3-4, you must pick the same **^^Delusion^^** as the one you picked last turn, even if it is on the warscroll of a unit that has been destroyed. In such cases, the effect of that **^^Delusion^^** applies as if the unit had not been destroyed. On a 5-6, you must pick a **^^Delusion^^** like you did in the first turn. For the rest of the turn, you believe the **^^Delusion^^** you picked.
abilities.declare: You must use this ability at the start of each turn. If it is the first turn of the battle, pick a **^^Delusion^^** from these battle traits or, unless otherwise specified, from the warscroll of a friendly unit on the battlefield. If it is not the first turn, make a delusion roll of D6.

abilities.name: A Glorious Banquet
abilities.effect: While you believe this **^^Delusion^^**, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts^^** units that charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Heroes^^**.

abilities.name: A Splendid Pageant
abilities.effect:
While you believe this **^^Delusion^^**:
• Each time a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts^^** unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Hero^^** uses a **^^Run^^** ability, if you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
• While a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Infantry Hero^^** unit is within the combat range of a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Infantry^^** unit that has 5 or more models, that **^^Hero^^** is not visible to enemy units more than 6" away.

abilities.name: Grasping Hands
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use **^^Run^^** or **^^Retreat^^** abilities while they are within this **^^Manifestation^^**'s combat range. In addition, if an enemy unit is picked to use a **^^Move^^** ability while it is within this **^^Manifestation^^**'s combat range, halve that unit's Move characteristic (rounding up) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Summon Cadaverous Barricade
abilities.effect: Set up a **Cadaverous Barricade** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Cadaverous Barricade** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Overflowing Gore
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, your opponent must pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
***Drink Deep from the Chalice:*** Other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks made by the target have no effect.
***Turn aside and Suffer the Consequences:*** Combat attacks that target that enemy unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.

abilities.name: Summon Chalice of Ushoran
abilities.effect: Set up a **Chalice of Ushoran** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Chalice of Ushoran** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Trampled Underfoot
abilities.effect:
This **^^Manifestation^^** can move a distance up to the value of the stampede roll in a straight line directly towards the target. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end that move in combat unless it ends that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, this  **^^Manifestation^^** has charged.
Roll a D3 for each enemy unit that this **^^Manifestation^^** passed across during that move. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
In addition, if this **^^Manifestation^^** charged this turn, add the value of the stampede roll to the Attacks characteristic of this **^^Manifestation^^**'s **Corpsemare Trample** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare:
This **^^Manifestation^^** can use this ability even if it is in combat.
Pick a point on a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, make a stampede roll of 2D6. Add 1D6 to the roll for each battle round that this **^^Manifestation^^** has been on the battlefield and has not been banished. For example, the stampede roll would be 2D6 in the turn it which it was summoned, 3D6 in your next turn, and so on.

For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's attacks, and add 1 to save rolls for this unit. At the start of the next turn, this unit is automatically destroyed.

abilities.effect: If this unit did not charge this turn and is in combat, it can move D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.

abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Move^^** ability for a unit in combat with this unit.
abilities.effect: After that **^^Move^^** ability has been resolved, this unit can move 2D6" but must end that move in combat with that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Mocking Dodge

abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Flensing Tongues
abilities.effect:
Until this **^^Manifestation^^** is banished or destroyed, the target is **tongue-tied** while it is within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**. While the target is **tongue-tied**:


• It cannot use **^^Run^^** abilities.
• Your opponent must roll a D6 instead of a D3 when determining the amount of mortal damage inflicted on the target when it uses a **^^Retreat^^** ability.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.

abilities.effect: If that enemy unit does not end the move closer to this **^^Manifestation^^** than it was at the start of the move, inflict D6 mortal damage on it after the **^^Move^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Summon Mesmerising Mirror

abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Mesmerising Mirror** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Exquisite Agony

abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Wheels of Excruciation** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: The Endless Dance
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:


***The Dance of Dreaming:*** Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, if the unmodified hit roll for an attack made by that enemy unit that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.


***The Pavane of Slaanesh:*** This unit can move 2D3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.


***The Waltz of Lethargy:*** Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target cannot use commands while it is in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: The Mirror's Depths
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
If the target is within 6" of this unit, the target is **gazing into eternity** until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target is **gazing into eternity** until the start of your next turn.


While the target is **gazing into eternity**, it must end all moves no further from this unit than it was at the start of the move and it cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up again on the battlefield.


**Designer's Note:** *This includes pile-in moves.*
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Swallow Energy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect:
If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value on the target's warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.


The next time a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a **^^Summon^^** ability, roll an additional D6, to a maximum of 3, when making the casting roll for that ability.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible **^^Manifestation^^** within 12" of this unit and that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6.

Pick 1 of the following delicacies for Glutos to savour. You cannot pick a delicacy that you picked in the previous turn. The effect applies for the rest of the turn.


***Hear of a Shadow Daemon:*** While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly non-**^^Monster Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.


***Blood of an Aelven Princeling:*** Each time a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a **^^Run^^** ability if you  roll a 1-3 when determining the diistance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.


***Crushed Incarnate's Core:*** Add 1 to unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit.


***Unspeakable Viscera:*** Inflict D6 mortal damage on each other unit (friendly and enemy) within this unit's combat range.

abilities.name: Maestros Of Discordance
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the enemy target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the enemy target.


Then, you can pick 1 of the following effects:
• **Heal (X)** the friendly target, where X is the number of enemy models slain by this ability this phase.
• Return a number of slain models to the friendly target unit with a total Health characteristic equal to or less than the number of enemy models slain by this ability this phase.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick another visible friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Daemon^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the friendly target.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.effect:

• Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together.  Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 3" of the target. On a 2+:

abilities.name: Ded Sneaky
abilities.effect: You can use the 'Sneaky Sneakin'' **^^Dirty Trick^^** ability twice per turn instead of only once per turn.

abilities.name: Meanest Beasts
abilities.effect: **Companion** weapons used by friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

abilities.name: Swamp Shroud
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** units that are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature are not visible to enemy units that are more than 12" away from them.

abilities.name: Far-killa Bolts
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets' ranged weapons.
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Man-skewer Boltboyz** or **Beast skewer Killbow** units to be the targets.

abilities.name: Gangin' Up
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** unit to be the target. That unit must be in combat with an enemy unit that is in combat with another friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** unit. **Kragnos** cannot be picked to be the target.

abilities.name: Krule Mockery
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **^^Move^^** ability and does not end that move closer to the **Insult Hurla** than it was at the start of the move, inflict D6 mortal damage on the target after that **^^Move^^** ability has been resolved.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** unit to be the **Insult Hurla**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of it to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

abilities.name: Dirty Tricks
abilities.effect:
The effect of a **^^Dirty Trick^^** ability is only applied if you make a successful dirty trick roll. The success of a dirty trick roll depends on the number of **^^Dirty Trick^^** abilities your army has already used this battle round:
**First:**  2+
**Second:** 3+
**Third:** 4+
**Fourth or subsequent:** 5+

abilities.name: Venom-encrusted Weapons
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target's attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Infantry^^** unit to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

abilities.name: Lethal Surprise
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. In addition, for the rest of the turn, the target's weapons cannot be affected by the Charge (+1 Damage) weapon ability
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** units to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

abilities.name: Sneaky Sneakin'
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Infantry^^** unit that has 10 or fewer models,  is not in combat and has not been the target of a **^^Dirty Trick^^** ability this turn to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

abilities.name: Noisy Racket
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: The target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with any friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** units to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

abilities.name: Wandering Destruction
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect:
Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part of this **^^Manifestation^^**.
 Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 3" of the target. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• That unit has the **^^Stomped^^** keyword until the start of your next turn.
• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for **^^Stomped^^** units, to a minimum of 1.
abilities.declare: Pick a part of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Summon Foot of Gork
abilities.effect: Set up a **Foot of Gork** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Foot of Gork** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Foot of Gork** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Bellowing Waaagh!-Cries
abilities.effect: Pick either 1 or 2 to add to casting rolls or chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a number of dice equal to the number picked. For each 1-2, allocate 1 damage point to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For each 5+, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** or **^^Ironjawz^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**. Friendly units can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** or **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^**  to be the target.

abilities.name: Summon Gork-Roara
abilities.effect: Set up a **Gork-Roara** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Gork-Roara** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Tricksy Footing
abilities.effect: Subtract 3 from the control score of enemy units while they are within 6" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Grasping Gunge
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use **^^Run^^** abilities while they are within 6" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Summon Morkspit Marsh
abilities.effect: Set up a **Morkspit Marsh** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Morkspit Marsh** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Summon Foot of Gork
abilities.effect: Set up a **Foot of Gork** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Foot of Gork** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Foot of Gork** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Summon Gork-Roara
abilities.effect: Set up a **Gork-Roara** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Gork-Roara** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Summon Morkspit Marsh
abilities.effect: Set up a **Morkspit Marsh** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Morkspit Marsh** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Choking Mist
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's weapons until the start of your next turn.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Da Black Pit
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Mork's Kunnin'
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to save rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** unit wholly within 12" of them, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Tattermask
abilities.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, that attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: Spell in a Rattle
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use a non-**^^Summon^^** **^^Spell^^** ability from a spell lore you picked during army composition as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**. Instead of making a casting roll for that spell, the casting roll is 9 and cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound.

abilities.name: Woggly Bogstikk
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Control characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Swamp Staff
abilities.effect: If this unit is not a **^^Wizard^^**, it can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**. Otherwise, add 1 to this unit's power level.

abilities.name: Mork's Eye Pebble
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared an **^^Attack^^** ability
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** units have **^^Ward (5+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Eye-biter Ash
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Slippery Skumbag
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, it can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

abilities.name: Egomaniak
abilities.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**^^Hero Kruleboyz^^** Infantry unit:
• This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**^^Hero Kruleboyz Infantry^^** unit within this unit's combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: Backstabba
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Add 1 to the mortal damage inflicted for each friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** unit in combat with the target in addition to the first two **^^Kruleboyz^^** units.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** in combat with both this unit and another friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Sly 'Un
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Quick 'Un
abilities.effect: Add half your fury level (rounding up) to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Spittin' 'Un
abilities.effect: This unit is armed with **Caustic Saliva**, where X is equal to your fury level.

Monstrous Traits.name: Monstrous Traits: Kruleboyz (Scourge of Ghyran)

abilities.name: Mean 'Un
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this unit's **Companion** weapons.

abilities.name: Sneaky 'Un
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use the 'Normal Move' or 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **^^Retreat^^** abilities this phase.

abilities.name: Tough 'Un
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

Monstrous Traits.restrictionText: Monstrous Traits are enhancements that can only be given to **^^Monsters^^**.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Fortcrusha Flail** is 11 for **Calamitous Sweep** and 4 for **Crushing Blow**.

abilities.name: Fortcrusha Flail
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a **^^Fight^^** ability, pick either the **Calamitous Sweep** or **Crushing Blow** weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its **Fortcrusha Flail**.

abilities.name: Rip It Up and Chuck It
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.effect:
Make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+:
• If the target is another **^^Big^^** unit, excluding **Gatebreaker Mega-Gargants**, it is armed with a **Hurled Boulder** for the rest of the turn (see the weapon profile on this unit's warscroll. Modifiers to this unit's ranged weapons or shooting attacks do not apply to the target).
• If the target is a **Gatebreaker Mega-Gargant** or a **^^Little^^** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.
• That terrain feature is **uprooted** for the rest of the battle. If it is **^^Faction Terrain^^**, inflict an amount of mortal damage on it equal to the rampage roll.
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit that is not **uprooted**, then pick a friendly **^^Sons of Behemat^^** unit within 3" of that terrain feature to be the target.

abilities.name: Primal Reckoning
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Fortcrusha Flail: Crushing Blow** for each friendly **^^Sons of Behemat^^** unit that has been destroyed this battle, to a maximum of 10.

upgrades.name: Regiment of Renown: Big Drogg Fort-kicker

abilities.name: Fortress Wrekka
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the 'Rip It Up and Chuck It' ability for the unit in this Regiment of Renown
abilities.effect: After picking the target for that ability, roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number. For each 4+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the unit in this Regiment of Renown's **Hurled Boulder** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Grievous Halitosis
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If any enemy models are slain by this ability, the target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Shipwrecka Warclub** is 11 for **Calamitous Sweep** and 4 for **Crushing Blow**.

abilities.name: Shipwrecka Warclub
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a **^^Fight^^** ability, pick either the **Calamitous Sweep** or **Crushing Blow** weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its **Shipwrecka Warclub**.

abilities.name: Get Orf Me Land!
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle, the target is this unit's **loot hoard**.

While the unit that used this ability is contesting its **loot hoard**, add 10 to its control score.

While the unit that used this ability is not contesting its **loot hoard**, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Almighty Stomp**.
abilities.declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature on the battlefield to be the target.

abilities.name: Greedy Show-Offs
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
If this unit is contesting its **loot hoard**, apply the effect below. Otherwise, make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly **^^Big^^** or **^^Little^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Dead Cunning, for a Gargant
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the unit in this Regiment of Renown has **^^Strike-last^^** and **^^Ward (5+)^^**. Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

***A Kunnin' Ruse:*** Other than the **Companion** ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target the unit in this Regiment of Renown have no effect.

***A Nasty Surprise:*** Add 1 to hit rolls for the unit in this Regiment of Renown's combat attacks and ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for its combat attacks.

***Tricked Ya!:*** Enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Cling On Tight

abilities.name: Ravenous Counter-Attack
abilities.effect: Enemy units do not count as having charged while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: We'll Be There - If the Pay's Right
abilities.effect: Set up the targets in reserve **preparing a flank attack**. They have now been deployed.
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the targets if none of them have been deployed.

abilities.name: The Horns Hit Home
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Set up the targets on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of each other, wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly unit that is **preparing a flank attack** to be the targets.

abilities.name: Almightier Stompin'

If any models are slain by those attacks, for the rest of the turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

abilities.name: Titanic Boulderclub
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a **^^Fight^^** ability, pick either the **Calamitous Sweep** or **Crushing Blow** weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its **Titanic Boulderclub**.

abilities.name: Titanic Stride
abilities.effect: The unit in this Regiment of Renown can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the unit in this Regiment of Renown by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Earth-shaking Stomp
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy **^^Infantry^^** and **^^Cavalry^^** units while they are in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Menhir Club** is 11 for **Calamitous Sweep** and 4 for **Crushing Blow**.

abilities.name: Leader of the Pack
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick another visible friendly **^^Sons of Behemat^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and make a rampage roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if the target is **^^Little^^**. On a 3+, the target's melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Primal Aura
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll for each other friendly **^^Big^^** or **^^Little^^** unit that is in combat and within this unit's combat range. On a 3+, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by abilities used by this unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Menhir Club

abilities.name: Protective Wards
abilities.effect: The unit in this Regiment of Renown has **^^Ward (6+)^^**.

abilities.name: Mighty Walloper
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the unit in this Regiment of Renown's **Menhir Club** has **Crit (2 Hits)** but all attacks made with that weapon this turn must target that enemy **^^Monster^^**.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.

abilities.name: Secret Tunnels
abilities.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **in a secret tunnel**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.

abilities.name: 'Neh Neh Na-neh Neh! Can't Catch Me!"
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the target can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Run^^** ability in the same turn, but each time it uses a **^^Move^^** ability, it must end the move closer to this unit.
In addition, for the rest of the turn, the first time the target ends a move within this unit's combat range, inflict D6 mortal damage on this unit.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Monster^^** or **^^Beast^^** unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Emerge from the Depths
abilities.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is in a secret tunnel.

abilities.name: Boing! Boing! Boing!
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit that passed across the target. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.

abilities.name: Squigs Gone Wild
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Herding Squigs
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each **Squig Herder** in this unit. For each 2+, you can return D3 slain **Cave Squigs** to this unit. For each 1, 1 **Squig Herder** in this unit is slain.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Hallucinogenic Fungus Brews
abilities.effect: In the first battle round, this unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^**. In the second battle round, this unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^**. In the third and subsequent battle rounds, this unit has **^^Ward (6+)^^**.

abilities.name: Gobbapalooza Know-wotz

abilities.effect:

abilities.name: Sneaky Distraction

This **^^Manifestation^^** can have a maximum of 6 **arcane charge points**.

abilities.name: Release Arcane Charge

abilities.name: Turn to Stone
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 6" of this **^^Manifestation^^**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If an enemy unit has at least 3 mortal damage inflicted on it by this ability this turn, it has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Rune of Petrification** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Sigil of Yngra

• Enemy abilities that would target this unit must target this **^^Manifestation^^** instead.

abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Sanctum of Amyntok** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Shrine Guardian
abilities.effect:
While this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian:
• This terrain feature has a Move characteristic of 6" and can use non-command non-**^^Charge^^** **^^Move^^** abilities as if it were a unit. It cannot end a **^^Move^^** ability within the combat range of an enemy unit.
• The Shrine Guardian cannot use **^^Move^^** abilities and remains on this terrain feature each time it moves.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to the Shrine Guardian, measure to this terrain feature instead.
• All attacks that would target the Shrine Guardian target this terrain feature instead.
• If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Shrine Guardian. Then, set up the Shrine Guardian on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shrine Guardian. If it is not possible to set up the Shrine Guardian, it is slain.

abilities.name: Enter the Shrine
abilities.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a Shrine Guardian (see 'Shrine Guardian').
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Shrine Guardian, pick a friendly **^^Lumineth Realm‑lords Infantry Hero^^** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.

abilities.effect: While this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian, you can re-roll the casting roll for that spell.

abilities.name: Exit the Shrine
abilities.effect: If this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Shrine Guardian on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shrine Guardian.
