abilities.name: Depict Rune
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following runes to depict on your **battle scripture**. The effect and conditional **enhanced** effects of that rune last for the rest of the battle round. Each rune remains on your **battle scripture** for the rest of the battle or until it is removed or replaced by another ability.
**Varinor, Rune of Strength**: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for each target. In addition, the following **enhanced** effects apply:
• While **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 1 to wound rolls for each target's combat attacks.
• While **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, each target can use **^^Shoot^^** and/or **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn.
**Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain**: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Each target has **^^Ward (5+)^^**. In addition, the following **enhanced** effects apply:
• While **Varinor, Rune of Strength** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, the targets' melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.
• While **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** is depicted on your **battle scripture**,subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with any of the targets.
**Ydriliqi, Rune of the River**: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Subtract 2 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of any of the targets. In addition, the following **enhanced** effects apply:
• While **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by the targets.
• If **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, each target can immediately move 3". They can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.
**Oreali, Rune of the Wind**: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with any of the targets. In addition, the following **enhanced** effects apply:
• While **Varinor, Rune of Strength** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 4" to each target's Move characteristic.
• While **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 5 to each target's control score.
**Thalari, Rune of the Zenith**: Add 2 to casting rolls for friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units. In addition, if you have 4 or more unique runes depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 4" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units and friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units' attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
**Designer's Note**: *We recommend noting the runes you have inscribed in each battle round on a piece of paper to keep track of which are currently depicted on your **battle scripture**. Feel free to note them by type (Strength, River, Mountain etc.), by initial (each has a different first letter) or if you are feeling particularly adventurous, you can try your hand at aelven calligraphy and learn to draw each rune!*

abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round

If it is the first battle round, roll a dice to determine which **^^Cycle^^** ability is ripe for the rest of the battle round.
**1** 'Unnatural Fecundity'
**2** 'Fecund Vigour'
**3** 'Burgeoning Filth'
**4** 'Plague of Misery'
**5** 'Nauseous Revulsion'
**6** 'Rampant Disease'
**7** 'Corrupted Regrowth'
If it is not the first battle round, the next **^^Cycle^^** ability in the sequence is ripe for the rest of the battle round. If the 'Corrupted Regrowth' ability was ripe last battle round, the 'Unnatural Vitality' ability is ripe this battle round.
You can only use a **^^Cycle^^** ability if it is ripe. Only 1 **^^Cycle^^** ability is ripe each battle round.
abilities.declare: You must use this ability at the start of each battle round.

abilities.name: Unnatural Vitality
abilities.effect: Friendly non-^^**Monster Cycle of Corruption Heroes^^** have **^^Ward (4+)^^**.

Add 1D6 to the roll for each battle round that this **^^Manifestation^^** has been on the battlefield and has not been banished. abilities.name: The Gaze of Nagash
abilities.effect:
Pick **normal gaze** or **empowered gaze**.
If you picked **normal gaze**, inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
If you picked **empowered gaze**, make an empowerment roll of 2D6. On a 6+, the roll succeeds, otherwise, the roll fails. You can keep making empowerment rolls until a roll fails. If an empowerment roll fails, the spell fails and its effect is not resolved. Otherwise, inflict D3+**X** mortal damage on each target, where **X** is the number of empowerment rolls that succeeded.
abilities.declare: Pick the friendly **Nagash** to cast this spell. Then, pick 2 points on the battlefield within 18" of and visible to him and within 12" of each other, Then, draw a line between those points, Each visible enemy unit the line passes across is a target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Roll 2D6 and add the number of **tasty morsels** you have to the roll. Apply the corresponding effect below for the rest of the battle round. Then, reset your **tasty morsels** to 0.
**2-3 – *Subdued:*** No effect.
**4-5 – *Peckish:*** Subtract 3 from the control scores of units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits**.
**6-8 – *Rumbling:*** Roll a dice for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.
**9-11 – *Famished:*** Units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits** cannot use commands.
**12+ – *Ravenous:*** Roll a D3 for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Pledges to the Dark Gods
abilities.effect:
Each time a friendly **^^Snow Peaks^^** unit uses 1 of the following abilities and the effect of that ability is resolved, gain 1 **oath point**.
• 'Oath of Bloodshed'
• 'Oath of Murder'
• 'Oath of Supremacy'
• 'Oath of the Marauder'
• 'Oath of the Raider'
• 'Oath of Conquest'
• 'Oath of Dark Sacrifice'
**Designer's Note:** *The abilities listed above are abilities on **^^Darkoath^^** warscrolls. By using those abilities (i.e. completing the oaths), the player gains* **oath points***, which can then be spent to use the* **^^Oath^^** *abilities in these Army of Renown rules.*

abilities.name: Hunger of Shesh'shan
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons
abilities.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **^^Snow Peaks^^** unit that has not used an **^^Oath^^** ability this turn to be the target.

abilities.name: Daemonfire Weapons
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons.
abilities.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **^^Snow Peaks^^** unit that has not used an **^^Oath^^** ability this turn to be the target.

abilities.name: Messengers of the Gods
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Spend 2 **oath points**. Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **^^Snow Peaks^^** **Darkoath Marauders** or **Fellriders** unit that has been destroyed and has not used an **^^Oath^^** ability this turn to be the target

abilities.name: Shroud of the Pale Elk
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an **^^Attack^^** ability
abilities.effect: If that friendly **^^Snow Peaks^^** unit has not used an **^^Oath^^** ability this turn, spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, that friendly unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
abilities.declare: A friendly **^^Snow Peaks^^** unit targeted by that **^^Attack^^** ability, if you have 1 or more **oath points**.

abilities.name: Rage of Arkhar
abilities.effect: Spend 2 **oath points**. The target can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **^^Snow Peaks^^** unit that has not used an **^^Oath^^** ability this turn to be the target.

abilities.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **^^Snow Peaks^^** unit that has not used an **^^Oath^^** ability this turn to be the target.

abilities.name: Summon Eightfold Doom-Sigil
abilities.effect: Set up an **Eightfold Doom-sigil** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Eightfold Doom-sigil** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Debilitating Shockwave
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If any models in the target unit are slain by this ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: If this **^^Manifestation^^** charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

abilities.name: Summon Realmscourge Rupture
abilities.effect: Set up a **Realmscourge Rupture** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Realmscourge Rupture** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Summon Darkfire Daemonrift
abilities.effect: Set up a **^^Darkfire Daemonrift^^** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Darkfire Daemonrift** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Summon Eightfold Doom-Sigil
abilities.effect: Set up an **Eightfold Doom-sigil** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Eightfold Doom-sigil** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Summon Realmscourge Rupture
abilities.effect: Set up a **Realmscourge Rupture** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Realmscourge Rupture** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Binding Damnation
abilities.effect: The target has **^^Strike-last^^** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Daemonic Speed
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Spite-tongue Curse
abilities.effect: Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. If the casting attempt is unsuccessful or if the spell is unbound, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

abilities.name: Aelfskin Scroll
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a **^^Wizard^^** within 18" of this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a visible friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness^^** **^^Wizard^^** within 18" of this unit. After that **^^Spell^^** ability has been resolved, that friendly **^^Wizard^^** can use a **^^Spell^^** ability as if it were your hero phase, and the casting roll for that spell is equal to the casting roll for that enemy spell. Do not count that spell towards the number of **^^Spell^^** abilities that friendly **^^Wizard^^** can use this phase.

abilities.name: Rune of Murder
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• Inflict 3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, double the target weapon's Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
• Add D6 to the target weapon's Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick 1 of this unit's melee weapons to be the target.

abilities.name: Darkflame Pendant
abilities.effect: Weapons used for attacks that target this unit have a maximum Damage characteristic of 1.

abilities.name: The Conquerer's Crown
abilities.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy **^^Infantry^^** units while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Realmwarper's Twist-rune
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If the target does not have the 'Obscuring' terrain ability, it gains that ability until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a dice for each model (friendly and enemy) within 1" of the target. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that model's unit.
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Infernal Puppet
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target is picked to use a **^^Spell^^** ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target as a reaction. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that **^^Spell^^** ability.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Wizard^^** within 24" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: The Varanite Shackle
abilities.effect: Friendly non-**^^Warriors of Chaos Slaves to Darkness^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Amulet of Chaos
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.
• If there is a friendly target, return a number of slain models to it equal to the roll.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly **^^Darkoath Infantry^^** unit in combat with that enemy unit to be the friendly target.

abilities.name: Head of the Unworthy
abilities.effect: If a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Hero^^** with any **Dark Apotheosis** points is destroyed, give this unit 8 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

abilities.name: Favoured of the Pantheon
abilities.effect: If this unit is picked as the target of the 'Eye of the Gods' ability, it gains 3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

abilities.name: Deathmonger
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Radiance of Dark Glory
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, **Heal (1)** the target. **Heal (3)** the target instead if it is a Monster.
abilities.declare: Pick each damaged friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Ensorcelled Banners.name: Ensorcelled Banners: Slaves to Darkness

abilities.name: The Eroding Icon
abilities.effect:
This unit has the **^^Pledged to Nurgle^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, attacks that target this unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

abilities.name: The Banner of Rage
abilities.effect:
This unit has the **^^Pledged to Khorne^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks.

abilities.name: The Banner of Screaming Flesh
abilities.effect:
This unit has the **^^Pledged to Slaanesh^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, if this unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: The Blasted Standard
abilities.effect:
This unit has the **^^Pledged to Tzeentch^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, this unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.

abilities.name: The Dread Banner
abilities.effect: While this unit includes any standard bearers, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.

Ensorcelled Banners.restrictionText: An Ensorcelled Banner is a unique enhancement that can be given to **^^Slaves to Darkness Infantry^^** and **^^Cavalry^^** units with the **^^Standard Bearer^^** keyword.  A unit can only have 1 Ensorcelled Banner.

Brands of the Dark Gods.name: Brands of the Dark Gods (Scourge of Aqshy)

abilities.name: Brand of Unbreakable Bonds
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of an objective you control and not in combat. This unit cannot use **^^Charge^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Brand of the Unaligned
abilities.effect:
Remove all of this unit's **^^Pledge to Chaos^^** keywords. Then, pick 1 of the following **^^Pledge to Chaos^^** keywords. You cannot pick a keyword you picked for this unit earlier in the battle.
• **^^Pledged to Khorne^^**
• **^^Pledged to Tzeentch^^**
• **^^Pledged to Nurgle^^**
• **^^Pledged to Slaanesh^^**
This unit has that keyword for the rest of the battle.
abilities.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it has an Ensorcelled Banner.

abilities.name: Brand of Apoplexy
abilities.effect: While your **fury level** is 7, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's weapons.

Brands of the Dark Gods.restrictionText: A Brand of the Dark Gods is a unique enhancement that can only be given to non-**^^Hero^^** **^^Slaves to Darkness^^** **^^Infantry^^** units.  A unit can only have 1 Brand of the Dark Gods.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged

abilities.name: Pitiless Warlord
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Charge^^** ability for an **^^Ogor Mawtribes^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: Re-roll 1 dice in that charge roll.

abilities.name: Glutthorn Stampede
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is **^^Infantry^^**. On a 4+, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

abilities.name: Ravenous Counter-Attack
abilities.effect: Enemy units do not count as having charged while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Shock and Gore

abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks.
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

abilities.effect: Set up the targets in reserve **preparing a flank attack**. They have now been deployed.
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the targets if none of them have been deployed.

abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Set up the targets on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of each other, wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly unit that is **preparing a flank attack** to be the targets.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: The target can move 2D6". It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that it was in combat with at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly **^^Big^^** or **^^Little^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that has not been set up this turn to be the target.

abilities.name: Almightier Stompin'
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.effect:

If any models are slain by those attacks, for the rest of the turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

abilities.name: Titanic Boulderclub
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a **^^Fight^^** ability, pick either the **Calamitous Sweep** or **Crushing Blow** weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its **Titanic Boulderclub**.

abilities.name: Titanic Stride
abilities.effect: The unit in this Regiment of Renown can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the unit in this Regiment of Renown by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Earth-shaking Stomp
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy **^^Infantry^^** and **^^Cavalry^^** units while they are in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Knell of Doom
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. If the target is within 6" of a friendly **Sloven Knights** unit, you can roll a D6 instead. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Omens of Decay
abilities.effect: Subtract twice the current battle round number from the target's control score for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, this ability affects all enemy units within 12" of this unit.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.name: Discomfiting Stench
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice.
• If the target is a **^^Wizard^^** and the roll exceeds the target's power level, until the start of your next turn, each time a casting roll for the target includes 2 or more rolls of 1, 2 or more rolls of 2 or 2 or more rolls of 3, the spell is miscast.
• If the target is a **^^Priest^^** and the roll exceeds the target's power level, until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent makes an unmodified chanting roll of 1 or 2 for the target, the prayer fails, its effect is not resolved and your opponent must remove D3 ritual points from the target. In addition, your opponent cannot give that **^^Priest^^** any ritual points for the rest of the phase.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** within 12" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Relentless Attackers
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's **Flyrider's Arsenal** for attacks that target enemy units contesting an objective.

abilities.name: Dispersed Formation
abilities.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

abilities.name: Fog of Despair
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target units in this Regiment of Renown while they are wholly within 9" of the **Harbinger of Decay** in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Nauseating Convalescence
abilities.effect: **Heal (1)** each unit in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Lunatic Demise
abilities.effect:
Each time a model in this unit is slain, before removing the model from play, pick 1 of the following effects: 
***Split:*** Pick a friendly **Blue Horrors and Brimstone Horrors** unit within 12" of this unit. Return up to 2 slain **Blue Horror** models to that unit. 
***Petty Vengeance:*** Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Imbued with Arcane Fire
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: The target's melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Arcanite^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Spellmaster
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a **^^Wizard^^** within 30" of this unit and the casting roll equalled or exceeded the spell's casting value and that spell has not been unbound
abilities.effect:
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved.
If the spell is unbound, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Radiant Transmogrification
abilities.effect:
Roll 2 dice, pick either result, then apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the turn:
**1** No effect.
**2-3** **Heal (D3)** each friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy target.
**4** Friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** targets can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if they used a **^^Run^^** ability in the same turn. Enemy targets cannot use **^^Run^^** abilities.
**5** Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
**6** Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by  friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** targets. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
abilities.declare: This **^^Manifestation^^** must use this ability in each hero phase. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the targets.

abilities.name: Summon Burning Sigil of Tzeentch
abilities.effect: Set up a **^^Burning Sigil of Tzeentch^^** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **^^Burning Sigil of Tzeentch^^** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Jaws of Fate
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Snapping Jaws** for each **fate point** you have.

abilities.name: Summon Daemonic Simulacrum
abilities.effect: Set up a **Daemonic Simulacrum** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Daemonic Simulacrum** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Compendium of Darkness
abilities.effect:
The target can immediately use a **^^Spell^^** ability from the Lore of Change or the Lore of Fate.
**Designer's Note**: *That spell does not count towards the number of **^^Spell^^** or **^^Banish^^** abilities the target can use this phase.*
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.

abilities.name: Summon Tome of Eyes
abilities.effect: Set up a **Tome of Eyes** wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Tome of Eyes** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points inflicted on it this turn by **^^Wyrdflame Spell^^** abilities or attacks made with weapons that have the **^^Wyrdflame^^** weapon ability to be the target.

abilities.name: Behold My Genius!

• Add 1 to hit rolls for the targets' shooting attacks.
• Add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets' ranged weapons.
abilities.declare: Pick all friendly **^^Volt-Klaw's Enginecoven^^** units to be the targets.

abilities.name: Longshanks

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Titanic Boulderclub** is 11 for **Calamitous Sweep** and 4 for **Crushing Blow**.

abilities.name: Don't Stomp Those; Stomp Them!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: The target can move 2D6". It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that it was in combat with at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly **^^Big^^** or **^^Little^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that has not been set up this turn to be the target.

abilities.name: Almightier Stompin'
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.effect:
Make a rampage roll of D3. For the rest of the turn, add the roll to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Almighty Stomp**, but all of this unit's attacks made with that weapon must target the target unit.

If any models are slain by those attacks, for the rest of the turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

abilities.name: Titanic Boulderclub
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a **^^Fight^^** ability, pick either the **Calamitous Sweep** or **Crushing Blow** weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its **Titanic Boulderclub**.

battleProfile.name: Warstomper Mega-Gargant
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout

abilities.name: Smash It All to Bits
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each friendly and enemy unit on the terrain feature that was picked. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. After rolling for all those units, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Big^^** unit that has not used a **^^Destructive Impulse^^** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick a terrain feature within its combat range. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of that **^^Big^^** unit to be the target.

abilities.name: The World Titan's Prophet
abilities.effect:
While any other friendly **^^Brodd's Stomp^^** units are within a friendly **King Brodd**'s combat range:
• That friendly **King Brodd** has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that friendly **King Brodd**, allocate 1 damage point to another friendly **^^Brodd's Stomp^^** unit within its combat range after the damage sequence for that friendly **King Brodd** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: Timberrrrr!
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly **^^Big^^** or **^^Little^^** model is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

abilities.name: Double Stomp
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add the result to the Attacks characteristic of the **Almighty Stomp** of the unit using this ability.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Big^^** unit that has not used a **^^Destructive Impulse^^** ability this turn to use this ability.

abilities.name: Wrath of Brodd
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Charge Phase
abilities.effect: If the unit using this ability charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit can move 3D6" but must end that move in combat. When it does so, it can pass through terrain features and enemy models as if it had **^^Fly^^**.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Big^^** unit that has not used a **^^Destructive Impulse^^** ability this turn to use this ability.

abilities.name: Watch This!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect:
If the target is a **^^Hero^^**, **^^Beast^^**, **^^Monster^^** or **^^War Machine^^**, roll 6 dice. Otherwise, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each roll that is equal to or greater than the target's Save characteristic, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

The **^^Big^^** unit using this **^^Destructive Impulse^^** ability has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Big^^** unit that has not used a **^^Destructive Impulse^^** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

abilities.name: Crafty Creepers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target no longer has that artefact of power.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Big^^** unit that has not used a **^^Destructive Impulse^^** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** that has an artefact of power and is in combat with that **^^Big^^** unit to be the target.

abilities.name: High Expectations
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^Brodd's Stomp^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of the chanter. If the chanting roll was 9+, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic instead.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Brodd's Stomp Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.name: I Can Do That Better
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the 'Wrath of Brodd' ability for a friendly unit
abilities.effect: This unit can use the 'Wrath of Brodd' ability immediately after the 'Wrath of Brodd' ability used by the other friendly unit has been resolved. This unit can do so even if it has used another **^^Destructive Impulse^^** ability this turn.

abilities.name: Lucky Shiny Hat
abilities.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage points inflicted by **^^Spell^^** and **^^Prayer^^** abilities and by abilities used by **^^Manifestations^^**.

abilities.name: Bet You Can't...
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

***...Kill the Big 'Eads!***: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target's melee weapons while they are in combat with any enemy **^^Heroes^^** or **^^Monsters^^**.

***...Get There Before Me!***: Up to 3 of the targets can each use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

***...Grab That!***: Add 5 to each target's control score for the rest of the battle.
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly **Mancrusher Gargant** on the battlefield to be the targets.

abilities.name: Excitable Followers
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a visible friendly **^^Sons of Behemat Hero^^**, this unit can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Statue Tossing
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the Damage characteristic of this unit's **Throwin' Rocks** is 3 instead of D3.
Then, you can spend up to 3 rage dice. If you do:
• For each rage dice spent, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Throwin' Rocks** for the rest of the turn.
• If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit in the enemy combat phase
abilities.effect: Pick a visible friendly **^^Big^^** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase

abilities.name: The Wandering Witch
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of another friendly **^^Sons of Behemat Monster^^** unit, this unit is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away from it.

abilities.name: Chooser of the Mighty
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

• For the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified wound roll of 6 for a combat attack made by the **mighty** unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target of the attack after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.

• Pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of the **mighty** unit, then pick a friendly non-**^^Unique^^** **^^Big^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target. Set up a replacement unit identical to the target within 1" of that point, then allocate 10 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). The replacement unit can only be set up in combat with units that the **mighty** unit was in combat with when it was picked to be **mighty**. Then, 1 model in the **mighty** unit is slain.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

***...Shoot Fire From Her Eyes!:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible enemy unit within 12" of the friendly **Ma Maegran**.

***...Turn You Into a Human!:*** Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of the friendly **Ma Maegran**. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with that unit.

***...Make Ya Big and Strong!:*** Pick another visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of the friendly **Ma Maegran**. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit's weapons for the rest of the turn.

***...Whiz the Biggest Bangers!:*** Add 1 to casting rolls for the friendly **Ma Maegran** until the start of your next turn.

abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Each target has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: If the friendly **Ma Maegran** is in combat and damaged, pick up to 3 friendly **Mancrusher Gargants** on the battlefield that are visible to her to be the targets.

abilities.name: Summon the Herd
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice for each target equal to the current battle round number. For each 4+, allocate 1 mortal damage to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.declare: If the friendly **Ma Maegran** is on the battlefield, pick each enemy non-**^^Fly^^** non-**^^Monster^^** unit that is visible to her to be the targets.

abilities.name: Don't Let Nuffin' Happen to Her!
abilities.effect:
While the friendly **Ma Maegran** is within the combat range of another friendly **^^Little^^** unit:
• She has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for her, allocate 1 mortal damage to another friendly **^^Little^^** unit within her combat range after the damage sequence for her has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
• Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for that other friendly **^^Little^^** unit's combat attacks.

abilities.name: A Shepherd's Watchful Eye
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **^^Matriarch's Mob^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster.
abilities.declare: Pick the friendly **Ma Maegran** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Sic 'Em!
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick the friendly **Ma Maegran** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Matriarch's Mob^^** unit wholly within 12" of her to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Mystical Demands
abilities.effect: If the target is in combat, it can use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase. If the target is not in combat, it can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase. In both cases, the target must end that move no further from the caster than it was at the start of the move.
abilities.declare: Pick the friendly **Ma Maegran** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Matriarch's Mob^^** unit wholly within 18" of her to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** or **^^Cavalry^^** unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target.

abilities.name: Hunt of the Bloodthirsty Shiver
abilities.effect:

***Ferocious Attack:*** While both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other's combat range, their **Allopex's Ferocious Bites** have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

abilities.name: Sweeping Blows
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Fight^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: If any damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **^^Fight^^** ability are allocated to any enemy units, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by those enemy units for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Thrallmaster
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Fight^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly **Namarti Thralls** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: Akhelian Insights
abilities.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **^^Namarti^^** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Strike On the Move

abilities.name: In the Shadow of the Ethersea
abilities.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve **in the ethersea**. They have now been deployed.
abilities.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown instead of the 'Deploy Unit' ability or the 'Deploy Regiment' ability.

abilities.name: Hunt of the Bloodthirsty Shiver
abilities.effect: Set up each unit on the battlefield wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge, more than 9" from all enemy units and within the combat range of another unit in this Regiment of Renown. Then, each unit can immediately move D3". The units cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown that is **in the ethersea**.

abilities.name: Captain of the Aelsling

abilities.name: Auxiliary Skyhook

• Subtract 1 from wound rolls made for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: She Can Handle It!
abilities.effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for the **^^Aelsling^^** while it is wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Assault Boat
abilities.effect:
This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll and must end the move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so:
• Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within this unit's combat range. The targets can be set up in combat.
• This unit and the targets have charged, and the targets cannot use another **^^Core^^** ability this phase.
• Pick up to 1 of the targets to have **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it is in combat or has used a **^^Run^^** or **^^Retreat^^** ability this turn. Pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity that are wholly within 6" of it, are not in combat and that have not charged this turn to be the targets. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.

abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

If the roll is higher than the target's Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked:
***Shieldbreaker:*** Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.
***Thunderdrakk:*** That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

***Don't Argue With the Wind:*** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
***There's No Trading With Some People:*** The target can use a **^^Retreat^^** ability and still use **^^Shoot^^** abilities later in the turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

quests.name: Search For The Artefact
quests.description:
At the end of each of your turns, you can pick a friendly **^^HERO^^** that is not within friendly territory, is not in combat and is within 1" of a terrain feature. If you do so, roll a dice. On a 4+, that **^^HERO^^** finds a clue and you gain 1 quest point.

Once you have gained 3 or more quest points, you can complete this quest. When you do so, you can give 1 artefact of power to an eligible **^^HERO^^** on your Order of Battle.

quests.name: Learn Ancient Scriptures
quests.description:
Each time a friendly **^^PRIEST^^** is given 4 or more ritual points, you gain 1 quest point.

Once you have gained 5 or more quest points, you can complete this quest. When you do so, you can pick 1 prayer from a prayer lore available to your army's faction and add it to your own prayer lore.

quests.name: Seek Glory In Battle
quests.description:
When you embark on this quest, pick a unit on your Order of Battle to be the Glory Seekers.

You can complete this quest the next time you win a major or minor victory and the Glory Seekers took part in the battle and were not destroyed. When you do so, the Glory Seekers earn D3+3 additional renown points.

quests.name: Master Magical Lore
quests.description:
Each time you make a casting roll of 8+ for a **^^WIZARD^^**, you gain 1 quest point.

Once you have gained 3 or more quest points, you can complete this quest. When you do so, you can pick 1 spell from a spell lore available to your army's faction and add it to your own spell lore.

quests.name: Harness Manifestation
quests.description: When you embark on this quest, pick 1 spell or prayer from a manifestation lore available to your army's faction and add it to your own manifestation lore marked as 'Wild'. Each time that spell or prayer is used, roll a dice. On a 1-3, inflict an amount of mortal damage equal to the roll on the unit using the ability. On a 4+, you gain a number of quest points equal to the roll. Once you have gained 10 or more quest points, you can complete this quest. When you do so, the spell or prayer is no longer marked as 'Wild'.

quests.name: Rise Of A Champion
quests.description:
When you embark on this quest, pick 1 **^^HERO^^** on your Order of Battle that does not yet have a heroic trait to be your Rising Champion.

You can complete this quest if an enemy **^^HERO^^** or **^^MONSTER^^** was slain by your Rising Champion. When you do so, you can give 1 heroic trait to your Rising Champion.

rules.description: Add the 'Nebulous' ability to your Landmark of Ghyran's warscroll.

rules.name: Node of Power
rules.description: Your Landmark of Ghyran has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

abilities.name: Deadly
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this terrain feature to be the target.

rules.name: Deadly
rules.description: Your hero has the 'Deadly' ability.

abilities.name: Sinister
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this terrain feature
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used, and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

rules.name: Sinister
rules.description: Add the 'Sinister' ability to your Landmark of Ghyran's warscroll.

abilities.name: Hidden Within
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
abilities.effect:
Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 7" of this terrain feature and more than 3" from all enemy units.
If the target is a **^^Hero^^**, **^^War Machine^^** or **^^Monster^^**, you must spend an additional command point to use this ability and if the target has a unit size of 1, you must allocate a number of damage points to the replacement unit equal to half its Health characteristic.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Unique^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

rules.name: Hidden Within
rules.description: You can only pick this upgrade if your Landmark of Ghyran is not a Reinforced Metalith. Add the 'Hidden Within' ability to your Landmark of Ghyran's warscroll.

abilities.name: Stalled Reinforcements
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve as **stalled reinforcements**. They have now been deployed. If any **stalled reinforcements** are part of a regiment, the other units in that regiment can still be deployed using the 'Deploy Regiment' ability.
abilities.declare: Pick a number of friendly units with a combined points value equal to or greater than the surplus value to be the targets.

abilities.name: Timely Arrival
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target is a **^^Hero^^** or reinforced unit and subtract 1 from the roll if the target is a **^^Monster^^**. On a 4+, set up the target in friendly territory wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If it is not possible to set up the target, it remains in reserve as a **Stalled reinforcement**.
abilities.declare: You can use this ability from the second battle round onwards. Pick a friendly **stalled reinforcement** to be the target.

abilities.name: Strategic Mastery
abilities.effect: If your opponent seized the initiative this battle round and you have not seized the initiative this battle, roll a dice for each command point your opponent has. For each 5+, your opponent loses 1 command point and you gain 1 command point.

abilities.name: Blighted Waters
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Your Turn
abilities.effect: Make a contamination roll of D3 for each target. On a 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. On a 2+, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Randomly pick a **contaminated** terrain feature. If that terrain feature has been **remediated** by your opponent's army, pick each friendly unit within 3" of that terrain feature to be the targets. Otherwise, pick each unit within 3" of that terrain feature to be the targets.

abilities.name: Purify the Land
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect:
Make a remediation roll of D6. On a 3+:
• The target is **remediated** by your army for the rest of the battle and you no longer consider it to be contaminated.
• The unit using this ability gains 2 renown points.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of a **contaminated** terrain feature to use this ability, then pick that **contaminated** terrain feature to be the target.

abilities.name: Boon of Vitality
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect below.
1-2 No effect.
3 Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
4 Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit until the start of your next turn.
5 The target has **^^Ward (5+)^^** until the start of your next turn.
6 The target can immediately use the 'Rally' command as if it were your hero phase without any command points being spent. If it does so, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and that is within 3" of a terrain feature that has been **remediated** by your army to be the target.

abilities.name: Headstrong and Eager
abilities.effect: Each time a unit in the Regiment of Ghyran uses the 'Charge' ability, if the unmodified charge roll was 2 or 3, you can use a value of 4 instead.

abilities.name: Bane of the Arcane
abilities.effect: If the casting roll for an enemy **^^Wizard^^** within 3" of a unit in this Regiment of Ghyran contains 2 or more results of 1 or 2, the spell is miscast.

abilities.name: Ghyranite Rangers
abilities.effect: Add 5 to the control scores of units in this Regiment of Ghyran while they are wholly within enemy territory.

abilities.name: Dirty Brawlers
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for units in this Regiment of Ghyran that did not charge in the same turn and are not in combat with any enemy units that charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: 'Sorry Sir, Didn't Catch That'
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a command for a unit in this Regiment of Ghyran
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 6+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
abilities.declare: You must use this ability.

abilities.name: To the Last
abilities.effect: Units in this Regiment of Ghyran cannot use **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Long-standing Animosity
abilities.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on each unit in this Regiment of Ghyran that is within the combat range of another unit in this Regiment of Ghyran.
abilities.declare: You must use this ability.

abilities.name: All Fingers and Thumbs
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from remediation rolls for units in this Regiment of Ghyran

abilities.name: Swift Skirmishers
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.effect:
Make a **swift move** for each target by rolling a number of D3 equal to the number of **swift points** it has. The target can move a number of inches equal to the swift move roll. It cannot move through or end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units.
After this ability has been resolved, your **swift points** are reset to 0 (any that have not been used are lost).
abilities.declare: You gain 1 **swift point** for each unit in this Regiment of Ghyran that is on the battlefield. Divide those **swift points** among those units in any combination. Then, pick each friendly unit that has any **swift points** to be the targets.

abilities.name: Poison-smeared Weapons
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by units in this Regiment of Ghyran while they are wholly within 6" of a **contaminated** terrain feature.

abilities.name: Emboldened by Purity
abilities.effect: Add 10 to the control scores of units in this Regiment of Ghyran while they are within 6" of a terrain feature that has been **remediated** by your army.

abilities.name: Forest Dwellers
abilities.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for units in this Regiment of Ghyran.

abilities.name: Cyclestone Amulets
abilities.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to a unit in this Regiment of Ghyran in each phase.

abilities.name: Contaminators
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+. the target is no longer **remediated** by your opponent's army and your opponent considers the target to be **contaminated**.
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature that has been **remediated** by your opponent's army and that is within 3" of a unit in this Regiment of Ghyran to be the target.

abilities.name: Take Cover
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Shoot^^** ability
abilities.effect:
Pick a unit in this Regiment of Ghyran to be the target. For the rest of the turn:
• If the unmodified hit roll for a shooting attack that targets this unit is 1-5, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
• The target cannot use **^^Charge^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Woodland Trappers
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect below until the start of your next turn.
**1-2** The target cannot use commands.
**3-4** Halve the target's Move characteristic.
**5-6** Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 6" of a unit in this Regiment of Ghyran, then pick each enemy unit within 6" of that terrain feature to be the targets.

abilities.name: Spell-breakers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the **^^Manifestation^^**'s warscroll, pick 1 of the following effects.
***Banish:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit that summoned the target. Then, the target is banished and removed from play.
***Take Control:*** For the rest of the turn, the target is treated as a friendly **^^Manifestation^^** by your army and as an enemy **^^Manifestation^^** by your opponent's army.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Manifestation^^** within 12" of a unit in this Regiment of Ghyran to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Sinister Saboteurs
abilities.effect: Subtract 2 from remediation rolls for enemy units while they are within 9" of 2 or more units in this Regiment of Ghyran.

abilities.name: Famed Courage
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared the 'Rally' command for a unit within 12" of and visible to a unit in this Regiment of Ghyran
abilities.effect: After that ability has been resolved, that friendly unit can immediately use the 'Rally' command. No command points are spent to use that command.

abilities.name: Jadeflower Seedbombs
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.declare: Pick a faction terrain feature or Landmark of Ghyran that is within 3" of a unit in this Regiment of Ghyran to be the target.

abilities.name: Synchronised Attacks
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, when players are alternating picking units to use a **^^Fight^^** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, you can pick each unit in this Regiment of Ghyran instead of 1. Resolve the **^^Fight^^** abilities one at a time immediately after each other.

abilities.name: Drawn to Corruption
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of a **contaminated** terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that is not in combat to be the target.

abilities.name: In It Together
abilities.effect: The targets can each move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. They can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. The **^^Hero^^** must move first, and the other target must end that move within the **^^Hero^^**'s combat range. If the **^^Hero^^** is unable to end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit, neither target can move. If they move, the targets have charged.
abilities.declare: If a **^^Hero^^** in this Regiment of Ghyran is not in combat and has not used any **^^Run^^** or **^^Retreat^^** abilities this turn, pick that **^^Hero^^** and 1 unit in this Regiment of Ghyran within its combat range that is not in combat and has not used any **^Run^^** or **^^Retreat^^** abilities this turn to be the targets. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Vigorous Spirits
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Roll **X**D3, where **X** is the number of enemy units within 12" of the target that used a **^^Move^^** ability this phase. The target can move a number of inches equal to the roll.
abilities.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that is not in combat to be the target.

abilities.name: Self-Preservation Instincts
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. On a 6+, the target can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.declare: Pick an unit in this Regiment of Renown that is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to be the target.

abilities.name: Blessings of Bark
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an **^^Attack^^** ability.
abilities.effect:
That unit has **^^Ward (3+)^^** for the rest of the phase. For each unmodified ward roll of 1 for that unit this phase, after the **^^Attack^^** ability has been resolved:
• If that unit has a Health characteristic of 1, 2 models in that unit are slain.
• If that unit has a Health characteristic of 2 or more, 1 model in that unit are slain.
abilities.usedBy: A unit in this Regiment of Ghyran targeted by that **^^Attack^^** ability

abilities.name: Master Cleansers
abilities.effect: You can re-roll remediation rolls for units in this Regiment of Ghyran.

abilities.name: Familiar with the Paths
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.effect:
Remove the targets from the battlefield. Set up the **oriented target** wholly within 6" of the **intended destination**. It can only be set up in combat with units in your opponent's army that were within 3" of the bewildered target before it was removed from the battlefield.
Then your opponent must set up the **bewildered target** wholly within 6" of the **unknown location**. It can only be set up in combat with units in your army that were within 3" of the oriented target before it was removed from the battlefield.
abilities.declare: Pick a unit n this Regiment of Ghyran to be the **oriented target**, then pick a point on the battlefield beneath the base of 1 of its models to be the **unknown location**. Next, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of the target to be the **bewildered target**, then pick a point on the battlefield beneath the base on 1 of its models to be the **intended destination**.

rules.name: Wizard Hero
rules.description: Your Regiment Hero has the **^^Wizard (1)^^** keyword. In addition, replace your Regiment Hero's melee weapon with a **Wizard's Staff**.

rules.name: Priest Hero
rules.description: Your Regiment Hero has the **^^Priest (1)^^** keyword. In addition, replace your Regiment Hero's melee weapon with a **Holy Sceptre**.

rules.name: Gigantic Hero
rules.description:
Change your Regiment Hero's Move characteristic to 6", their Health characteristic to 8 and their Control characteristic to 5.
In addition, replace your Regiment Hero's melee weapon with a **Great Weapon of Renown**.

rules.name: Gargantuan Hero
rules.description:
Replace your Regiment Hero's **^^Infantry^^** keyword with the **^^Monster^^** keyword.
Change your Regiment Hero's Move characteristic to 8", their Health characteristic to 12 and their Control characteristic to 10.
In addition, replace your Regiment Hero's melee weapon with a **Monstrous Weapon of Renown** and **Massive Punches or Kicks**.

Ghyranite Steed's Teeth, Hooves, or Claw.name: Ghyranite Steed's Teeth, Hooves, or Claws

weapons.name: Ghyranite Steed's Teeth, Hooves, or Claws

rules.name: Ghyranite Steed
rules.description:
Add the **Ghyranite Steed's Teeth, Hooves, or Claws** weapon to your Regiment Hero's warscroll. 
In addition, make the following changes to your Regiment Hero's warscroll:
• Change the Move characteristic to 12".
• Add 2 to the Health characteristic.
• Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
• Replace the **^^Infantry^^** keyword with the **^^Cavalry^^** keyword.

rules.name: Ghyranite Behemoth
rules.description:
Add the **Ghyranite Behemoth's Jaws** weapon to your Regiment Hero's warscroll. 
In addition, make the following changes to your Regiment Hero's warscroll:
• Change the Move characteristic to 10".
• Add 6 to the Health characteristic.
• Add 3 to the Control characteristic.
• Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
• Replace the **^^Infantry^^** keyword with the **^^Monster^^** keyword.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Ghyranite Monstrosity's Claws** is 4.

rules.name: Ghyranite Monstrosity
rules.description:
Add the **Ghyranite Monstrosity's Maw** and **Ghyranite Monstrosity's Claws** weapons and the 'Battle Damaged' ability to your Regiment Hero's warscroll. 
In addition, make the following changes to your Regiment Hero's warscroll:
• Change the Move characteristic to 12".
• Add 8 to the Health characteristic.
• Add 5 to the Control characteristic.
• Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
• Replace the **^^Infantry^^** keyword with the **^^Monster^^** keyword.

rules.name: Renowned Warrior
rules.description: Add 1 to your Regiment Hero's Control characteristic.

rules.name: Realm Wanderer
rules.description: Add 1 to your Regiment Hero's Move characteristic.

rules.name: Imposing Presence
rules.description: Add 1 to your Regiment Hero's Health characteristic.

weapons.name: Ghyranite Steed's Teeth, Hooves, or Claws

rules.name: Expert Fighter
rules.description: Pick 1 of your Regiment Hero's weapons. Improve that weapon's Hit characteristic by 1 (for example, 4+ becomes 3+).

rules.name: Powerful Strikes
rules.description: Pick 1 of your Regiment Hero's weapons. Improve that weapon's Wound characteristic by 1 (for example, 4+ becomes 3+).

rules.name: Muscular Physique
rules.description: Pick 1 of your Regiment Hero's weapons. Add 1 to that weapon's Rend characteristic.

abilities.name: Local Knowledge
abilities.effect: Add 1 to remediation rolls for your Regiment Hero.

rules.name: Local Knowledge
rules.description: Add the 'Local Knowledge' ability to your Regiment Hero's warscroll.

rules.name: Specialist Training
rules.description: Pick 1 of your Regiment Hero's non-**Companion** weapons, then pick 1 of the following weapon abilities: **Charge (+1 Damage)**, **Crit (2 Hits)**, **Crit (Auto-wound)**, **Shoot in Combat**. That weapon has the weapon ability you picked.

rules.name: Razor-sharp Weapon
rules.description: Pick 1 of your Regiment Hero's melee weapons. That weapon has **Crit (Mortal)**.

rules.name: Ironoak Armour
rules.description: Improve your Regiment Hero's Save characteristic by 1 (for example, 5+ becomes 4+).

rules.name: Sky-born
rules.description: Your Regiment Hero has **^^Fly^^**.

rules.name: Aura of Immortality
rules.description: Your Regiment Hero has **^^Ward (6+)^^**

abilities.name: Back to Back
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Fight^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero^^** unit in this Regiment of Renown that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

rules.name: Back to Back
rules.description: Add the 'Back to Back' ability to your Regiment Hero's warscroll.

rules.name: Ghyranite Ranged Weapon
rules.description: Add a **Ghyranite Ranged Weapon** to your Regiment Hero's warscroll. You cannot pick this upgrade if your Regiment Hero already has a ranged weapon.

rules.name: Ghyranite Heavy Ranged Weapon
rules.description: Add a **Ghyranite Heavy Ranged Weapon** to your Regiment Hero's warscroll. You cannot pick this upgrade if your Regiment Hero already has a ranged weapon.

rules.name: Ghyranite Mount
rules.description:
Non-**^^Hero Infantry^^** only.
Add the **Ghyranite Mount's Teeth, Hooves, or Claws** weapon to your Regiment Hero's warscroll. 
Then, make the following changes to your Regiment Hero's warscroll:
• Change the Move characteristic to 12".
• Change the Health characteristic to 3 or add 1 to the Health characteristic.
• Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
• Replace the **^^Infantry^^** keyword with the **^^Cavalry^^** keyword.

rules.name: Ghyranite Fiend
rules.description:
Non-**^^Hero Infantry^^** or **Ghyranite Chariot** only.
If the unit is **^^Infantry^^**, add the **Ghyranite Fiend's Jaws** weapon to your Regiment Hero's warscroll. If the unit is a **Ghyranite Chariot**, replace its **Companion** weapon with **Ghyranite Fiend's Jaws**.
In addition, make the following changes to your Regiment Hero's warscroll:
• Change the Move characteristic to 10".
• Add 6 to the Health characteristic.
• Add 3 to the Control characteristic.
• Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
• Replace the **^^Infantry^^** keyword with the **^^Monster^^** keyword.

rules.name: Ghyranite Colossus
rules.description:
Non-**^^Hero^^** non-**^^Beast^^** unit only.
If the unit is **^^Infantry^^**, **^^Monster^^**, or a **Ghyranite Bombard**, add the **Ghyranite Monstrosity's Maw** and **Ghyranite Monstrosity's Claws** weapons and the 'Battle Damaged' ability to your Regiment Hero's warscroll. If the unit is a **Ghyranite Chariot**, replace its **Companion** weapon with the **Ghyranite Monstrosity's Maw** and **Ghyranite Monstrosity's Claws** weapons.
In addition, make the following changes to your Regiment Hero's warscroll:
• Change the Move characteristic to 12".
• Add 5 to the Health characteristic.
• Add 5 to the Control characteristic.
• Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
• If the unit is **^^Infantry^^**, replace the **^^Infantry^^** keyword with the **^^Monster^^** keyword. If the unit is a **^^War Machine^^**, it also has the **^^Monster^^** keyword.

rules.name: Ghyranite Mount
rules.description:
Non-**^^Hero Infantry^^** only.
Add the **Ghyranite Mount's Teeth, Hooves, or Claws** weapon to your Regiment Hero's warscroll. 
Then, make the following changes to your Regiment Hero's warscroll:
• Change the Move characteristic to 12".
• Change the Health characteristic to 3 or add 1 to the Health characteristic.
• Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
• Replace the **^^Infantry^^** keyword with the **^^Cavalry^^** keyword.

rules.name: Ghyranite Fiend
rules.description:
Non-**^^Hero Infantry^^** or **Ghyranite Chariot** only.
If the unit is **^^Infantry^^**, add the **Ghyranite Fiend's Jaws** weapon to your Regiment Hero's warscroll. If the unit is a **Ghyranite Chariot**, replace its **Companion** weapon with **Ghyranite Fiend's Jaws**.
In addition, make the following changes to your Regiment Hero's warscroll:
• Change the Move characteristic to 10".
• Add 6 to the Health characteristic.
• Add 3 to the Control characteristic.
• Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
• Replace the **^^Infantry^^** keyword with the **^^Monster^^** keyword.

rules.name: Ghyranite Colossus
rules.description:
Non-**^^Hero^^** non-**^^Beast^^** unit only.
If the unit is **^^Infantry^^**, **^^Monster^^**, or a **Ghyranite Bombard**, add the **Ghyranite Monstrosity's Maw** and **Ghyranite Monstrosity's Claws** weapons and the 'Battle Damaged' ability to your Regiment Hero's warscroll. If the unit is a **Ghyranite Chariot**, replace its **Companion** weapon with the **Ghyranite Monstrosity's Maw** and **Ghyranite Monstrosity's Claws** weapons.
In addition, make the following changes to your Regiment Hero's warscroll:
• Change the Move characteristic to 12".
• Add 5 to the Health characteristic.
• Add 5 to the Control characteristic.
• Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
• If the unit is **^^Infantry^^**, replace the **^^Infantry^^** keyword with the **^^Monster^^** keyword. If the unit is a **^^War Machine^^**, it also has the **^^Monster^^** keyword.

abilities.name: Cremated Pendant

abilities.name: Forthright Fury

abilities.name: Words of Blazing Power

abilities.name: Spiteful Spark

abilities.name: Tainted Radiance

abilities.name: Cascading Fire Cloak

abilities.name: Embody the Blaze

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit that is in combat and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Flaming Blades of Ruin

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Fulminating Flame-cage
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent declares an ability for the target, as a reaction, roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick an enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Pyroclastic Repression

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: Volcanic Blast

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.name: Crumbling Impact
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time an enemy unit ends a move made as part of a **^^Charge^^** ability within 3" of the target, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit after the **^^Charge^^** ability has been resolved. abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.name: Invocation to Wrath
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick up to 2 eligible units to be the targets instead of 1
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.name: Leaping Embers
abilities.effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for the target until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 4 to charge rolls for the target until the start of your next turn instead.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

If the chanting roll was 8+, after the **^^Retreat^^** ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit that was in combat with the target at the start of the move.
• No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by
**^^Retreat^^** abilities.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
